## 5‑Day Instagram Content Plan  
*(All captions include the hashtag palette: #FadedArchive, #TeeLove, #PrintOnDemand, #ShopLocal, #NewDrop)*

| Day | Post Type | Visual Idea | Caption |
|-----|-----------|-------------|---------|
| **Day 1** | Logo teaser | Black‑out silhouette of the Faded Archive logo, subtle animated glow | “🔍 Something new is coming… Can you guess what it is? Stay tuned. #FadedArchive” |
| **Day 2** | Behind‑the‑scenes | Quick loop of the design being printed on a tee, quirk (e.g., coffee spill, zoom on thread) | “From idea to ink—here’s how your favourite tee is made. #TeeLove” |
| **Day 3** | Style‑in‑action | Model in an urban setting, showing off the tee, wearing layers | “Built for the streets, made for anyone. Which look is your vibe? Drop a 🎨 below. #PrintOnDemand” |
| **Day 4** | Shop‑feature | Flat lay of the first 10 designs, swipe‑album effect | “Sneak peek: our first drop. Which one will you grab? #FadedArchive” |
| **Day 5** | Launch CTA | Shop‑front shot with “Now live” banner, countdown sticker | “It’s official—your tees are here! Shop now and use code LAUNCH10 for 10% off #NewDrop” |

**Post‑script**: Use Stories each day with polls (e.g., “What’s your favourite color?”) and a “Swipe up” link (or link‑in‑bio) to drive traffic.

## eBay UK Fees for Clothing (quick reference)

| Revenue Source | Fee | Minimum/Cap |
|-----------------|-----|-------------|
| **Final Value Fee** | 10 % of the sale price | Trigger‑based “Lower Final Value Fees” tiers apply below £50; highest 10 % |
| **Listing Fee** | £0.50 per single‑listing | Free for the first 50 listings per month |
| **PayPal / eBay Payments** | 2.9 % + £0.30 per transaction | Same as final‑value fee |
| **Optional “Featured”** | £3.50 per day | Adds visibility; optional not mandatory |
| **Storage Fees** | None (if items are sold within 30 days) | If unsold >30 days, £0.30/month per item |

**Total Cost Example**  
Selling a £25 tee:  
- Final value (10 %) = £2.50  
- Listing = £0.50 (first 50 free?) → £0  
- PayPal = 2.9 % + £0.30 = £0.80  
**≈£3.30 total** (~13 % of price)

*Tip:* Use the eBay “Calculate Fees” tool or the seller dashboard’s fee calculator for exact amounts each listing.
